## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: An integration test creates a CLI_user + detected_by:<channel> ticket programmatically and asserts the tag round-trip

Create `tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh` — an executable bash integration test that, for each of the 7 allowed detected_by channel values (tests, review-llm, review-human, production, user-report, internal-dogfood, other), creates a bug ticket via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug ... --tags CLI_user --tags detected_by:<channel>`, runs `.claude/scripts/dso ticket show <id>`, asserts BOTH the CLI_user tag AND the detected_by:<channel> tag appear in the show output, then cleans up via `ticket delete --user-approved`.

Use `mktemp` for any temp files. Set the executable bit on the new .sh file. The test must source `tests/lib/assert.sh` if available; on failure emit `FAIL:` lines and exit non-zero.

This test proves the ticket CLI honors the new tag format end-to-end and locks in the round-trip contract that task-2's SKILL.md instruction relies on. The test is independent of SKILL.md and bug-report-template.md content — it directly exercises the ticket CLI.

## Testing Mode
RED — write the integration test; it establishes the behavioral contract that SKILL.md instruction (task-2) depends on.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Integration test file exists and is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh
- Test enumerates all 7 allowed detected_by values verbatim — Verify: for v in tests review-llm review-human production user-report internal-dogfood other; do grep -q "detected_by:$v" tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh || { echo "MISSING: $v"; exit 1; }; done
- Test creates a ticket with both CLI_user and detected_by:<channel> tags and asserts round-trip — Verify: grep -q 'ticket create bug' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh && grep -q 'CLI_user' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh && grep -q 'ticket show' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh
- Test cleans up tickets it creates via ticket delete --user-approved — Verify: grep -q 'ticket delete .*--user-approved' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh
- Test uses mktemp for any temp files (no hardcoded /tmp/ paths) — Verify: ! grep -E '/tmp/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(\s|"|$)' tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh | grep -v mktemp
- Running the integration test exits 0 (tag round-trip succeeds for all 7 values) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-create-bug-detected-by-integration.sh — Create
data.title: Add integration test asserting CLI_user + detected_by:<channel> tag round-trip via ticket CLI
